summary_out.hypothesis: Threshold sweep variant (1.5 → 1.7) to test whether chop_neutral=1.5 — verbatim from vrs-isl-g1l1's surviving-population calibration — is the right operating point on this base's spread-pre-filtered chop_ratio distribution. The pre-stated hypothesis was that the spread pre-filter narrows the surviving distribution so 1.5 sits in the body and the optimum is higher. The data falsifies that: between 1.5 and 1.7 the surviving chop_ratio distribution has near-zero mass on this composed stack, so neither threshold dominates. Combined with island-0 g2l2 (porting 1.5 to ptg admitted only ~1.7k trades) and island-2 g1l1 (1.5 is its lineage optimum), the chop_neutral=1.5 operating point appears base-robust — falsifying the gen-2 migration `base_specific` (1) claim for the chop gate specifically.
summary_out.next: Chop calibration is exhausted on this base — neither tightening (1.3, risky given g2l2 was already -6.6% trade_count) nor loosening (this loop, 1.7, flat) opens headroom. The g3l1 hypothesis explicitly partitioned the next direction into three options: (a) probabilistic chop dosage (per island-2 g1l1's exponential decay form) replacing the binary, (b) top-of-book size asymmetry as a structurally distinct fourth orthogonal SKIP axis on top of the unmodified spread+chop(1.5)+flow stack, (c) a different fourth axis from the gen-2 migration's named candidates. Recommendation for g3l2: option (b) — top-of-book bid_size/ask_size ratio is the most independent-from-existing candidate (book-DEPTH imbalance is structurally distinct from spread's quote-DISTANCE and from flow's signed-trade pressure; volume bursts correlate with flow; time-of-day correlates with spread). Composition rule: binary AND-skip (consistent with g2l2's working composition). Falsification for g3l2: if trade_count drops >10% OR pnl regresses, the three-axis ceiling is real on this base and the alternative direction is probabilistic chop (option a). Note for cross-island migration: this null result is itself evidence that chop_neutral=1.5 is base-robust across all three island bases — a falsification of the gen-2 migration `base_specific` (1) chop-specific retuning claim, which other islands' g3 loops should also see corroborated.
